name: Darian Stomgard
original_name: ダリアン＝ストムガルト
source:
The Queen of Stomgard Kingdom. Darian is officially descended from the heroes who sealed Astaroth 200 years ago. She is a cunning ruler but her high handed ways has earned her dissatisfaction among her ministers.

[spoiler]Depending on the route players take, she is eventually unmasked as an imposter when Hymns obtains secret documentation revealing the palace coup which dethroned and killed the monarch of Stromgard several generations before her reign.

The Queen of Stomgard Kingdom. Darian is officially descended from the heroes who sealed Astaroth 200 years ago. She is a cunning ruler but her high handed ways has earned her dissatisfaction among her ministers.
